transformation_blueprint.core_mission: Zero-upfront-capital autonomous coding bounty discoverer, evaluator, researcher, solver, reviewer, PR generator, and financial outcome tracking platform.

preserve_infrastructure: Backend FastAPI server skeleton & gateway configuration (/backend/server.py, gateway_config.py)
MongoDB client connections & async database session setup
Sonner toast notifications and Lucide React icons
disable_deactivate_dropshipping: Deactivate dropshipping agent workflows, Shopify/AliExpress API endpoints, and product catalog scrapers
Replace dropshipping database schemas with Bounty Jobs, Opportunities, Financial Ledger, and Audit Logs
Update main navigation and dashboard pages to Coding Bounty Command Center

theme_rules.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing System (p-4 to p-12 with 1px tactile borders and internal p-6 padding to prevent edge text collision)

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-100

visual_enhancers.card_style: Cardless or sharp 1px solid bordered containers (border-[#1E2230]) with bg-[#12141D] and optional sub-pixel top highlight border border-t-[#2E354A]
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Header and sticky navigation using backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#090A0F]/85 border-b border-[#1E2230]
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Subtle status indicators with soft radial glow (e.g. shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(34,197,94,0.2)] for ONLINE state, shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(249,115,22,0.25)] for WORKING state)
visual_enhancers.badge_styles: Monospace pill badges with tinted background (e.g., bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20)

navigation_and_structure.layout_type: Sidebar Command Center with Top Status Header

emergency_header.global_stop_button: Prominent Red Emergency Stop with Confirmation Modal (data-testid='emergency-global-stop-button')
emergency_header.budget_ticker: Live Available Capital ($0.00 initial bootstrap), Verified Revenue, Active Spend
emergency_header.autonomy_mode_badge: Current Mode Indicator: OBSERVE | ASSISTED | AUTONOMOUS

components.name: CommandLayout
components.description: Main layout wrapper containing sidebar, header with emergency stop, live capital counter, and alert banner.

components.name: MainDashboard
components.description: Primary metrics overview: Available Capital, Verified Revenue, Net Profit, Active Jobs, Pipeline Value, Agent Fleet Status grid, and Recent Audit Events.

components.name: BountyBoard
components.description: Sortable/filterable table for discovered opportunities with Expected Profit, Success Probability, Difficulty, Risk Score, and PURSUE/IGNORE actions.

components.name: ActiveJobView
components.description: Lifecycle stepper (Scout -> Research -> Coding -> Testing -> Security -> Review -> PR -> Payment) with real-time agent output logs, diff viewer, and Human Approval Gate.

components.name: AgentFleetStatus
components.description: Grid of 12 specialized agents (Master, Scout, Evaluator, Researcher, Coder, Tester, Security, Reviewer, PR Manager, Outcome Tracker, Payment Tracker, Finance, Learning) showing state (ONLINE, WORKING, IDLE, BLOCKED, ERROR).

components.name: FinanceDashboard
components.description: Bootstrap financial ledger (Levels 0-4), gross/verified revenue, operating budget, reserves, reinvestment sliders, and compute cost breakdown charts.

components.name: SecurityCenter
components.description: Sandbox isolation status, credential/API key states (CONNECTED / MISSING / REVOKED - secrets NEVER exposed), repository allowlists, and blocked operations log.

components.name: HumanApprovalGate
components.description: Review panel showing diff viewer, test reports, security clearance, PR preview, and action buttons (APPROVE SUBMISSION, REJECT, REQUEST CHANGES, ABORT).

chart_types.usage: Verified Revenue vs Operating Capital over time
Bounty Expected Profit by Language & Source

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, toggle switches, table action buttons, modal dialogs) MUST include explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_and_accessibility: APCA & WCAG AA 4.5:1 text-to-background contrast minimum. All icon-only buttons must have aria-label and data-testid. Focus states must feature a 2px offset ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#F97316]).

instructions_to_main_agent: Transform existing OpenClaw dropshipping project in /app without creating a standalone external app.
Use JavaScript (.js and .jsx files) as existing frontend codebase uses .js.
Preserve Google auth callback and Shadcn UI component wrappers in /frontend/src/components/ui/.
Ensure ALL interactive buttons, table rows, form elements, and state cards possess precise data-testid attributes for E2E testing.
Do NOT hardcode simulated revenues as final verified earnings without clear distinction in the ledger.
In corporate/command-center dashboard views, NEVER use Space Grotesk or teal green (#1B93A4). Use Outfit for headings, Fira Sans for text, Fira Code/JetBrains Mono for metrics and code diffs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain bright gradient full-screens. Use dark structured command center layouts with 1px border grid divisions.
Micro-interactions: Hover states on all buttons and table rows with smooth transition-colors (duration-150 ease-in-out). Exclude transforms from universal transitions.
Generous padding: Cards and section containers must have internal padding (p-5 or p-6) to avoid text touching borders.
Use Sonner toasts (/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx) for alert notifications and operational status changes.
All agent statuses must be visually distinct with color badges (Green = ONLINE/WORKING, Yellow = IDLE/WAITING_APPROVAL, Red = BLOCKED/ERROR).
